typesense:trending.greeting:
NEW YORK CITY — MONDAY, 8:17 AM

Another morning begins in a world where mutants, superheroes, gods, aliens, sorcerers, and ordinary humans somehow share the same streets.

News screens across Manhattan cycle through the morning headlines:

SENTINEL OVERSIGHT BILL RETURNS TO CONGRESS

MUTANT ACTIVITY REPORTED IN BROOKLYN

XAVIER INSTITUTE DECLINES COMMENT

At Empire State University, hundreds of students pour across campus. Some are human. Some are mutants. A few are something else entirely.

Across the city, Xavier’s Institute is already awake. Scott Summers oversees morning training while Jean Grey speaks with several students outside the mansion. Logan has disappeared somewhere into Westchester. Ororo Munroe is preparing for a meeting concerning growing anti-mutant tensions.

Elsewhere, Emma Frost has business of her own.

Magneto hasn’t been seen publicly in weeks.

And beneath New York, rumors are spreading among the Morlocks that something strange has begun moving through the tunnels.

None of these people know who you are unless they have a reason to.

They don’t know your abilities.

They don’t know your history.

They don’t know what you’re capable of.

Not yet.

You may be a mutant, human, enhanced individual, sorcerer, alien, demigod, experiment—or something without a convenient classification.

You may seek Xavier.

You may oppose him.

You may join the X-Men, Brotherhood, Hellfire Club, another faction, create your own, or refuse all of them.

The world will respond to what you actually do.

Your story begins wherever you choose.

Introduce your character and where they currently are.
typesense:trending.name: X-Men: Mutant Era V2
typesense:trending.title: An open-world Marvel mutant RPG where your choices shape the story
